name: Solana mainnet halt (JIT cache bug)
technique: Infinite recompile loop in program cache
rootCause: A bug in the Agave JIT program cache caused an infinite recompile loop when a legacy loader program was invoked, stalling block production for ~5 hours until validators upgraded and restarted.
